extracted.intended_audience: NLP / machine-learning researchers and practitioners working on sarcasm detection and dataset creation
extracted.subtask_description: Creation and release of a large, self-annotated Reddit corpus (SARC) intended for training and evaluating sarcasm-detection systems; includes dataset characteristics, labeling provenance, contextual metadata, and baseline evaluations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corpus purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: A large corpus for sarcasm research and for training and evaluating systems for sarcasm detection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The dataset is explicitly intended to support both research and the training/evaluation of automated sarcasm-detection systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Size / scale
rubrics_metrics.description: The corpus has 1.3 million sarcastic statements -- 10 times more than any previous dataset -- and many times more instances of non-sarcastic statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Large scale (1.3M sarcastic examples) is emphasized as a key quality; the magnitude enables stronger empirical learning and comparisons to prior smaller datasets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for balanced and unbalanced regimes
rubrics_metrics.description: Allows for learning in both balanced and unbalanced label regimes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because the corpus contains many more non-sarcastic instances in addition to the large number of sarcastic statements, it supports experiments under different class-balance conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Self-annotation (label provenance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each statement is furthermore self-annotated -- sarcasm is labeled by the author, not an independent annotator.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Labeling is author-provided (self-annotated); this provenance is a deliberate design choice that affects label interpretation (e.g., reflects author intent rather than external annotation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Contextual metadata provided
rubrics_metrics.description: Statements are provided with user, topic, and conversation context.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The dataset includes surrounding contextual information (user, topic, conversation) to enable context-aware sarcasm detection methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corpus validation and benchmarking
rubrics_metrics.description: We evaluate the corpus for accuracy, construct benchmarks for sarcasm detection, and evaluate baseline methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The paper includes evaluations of corpus accuracy and provides benchmark tasks and baseline method results to facilitate comparison and reproducible evaluation.
